description_en: Updates an alert rule for a synchronization task
description_zh: 更新数据集成新版任务告警规则，当前支持的任务类型包括：MySQL到Hologres整库实时解决方案
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public update-di-alarm-rule --di-alarm-rule-id 34982 --metric-type Heartbeat --trigger-conditions Severity=Warning Duration=15 Threshold=5 --notification-settings '{"NotificationChannels":[{}],"InhibitionInterval":5,"NotificationReceivers":[{}]}' --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDIAlarmRule

parameters.help_zh:
告警规则ID。

可通过 ListDIAlarmRules 响应中的 DIAlarmRulePaging.DIJobAlarmRules[].DIAlarmRuleId 获取
parameters.name: di_alarm_rule_id

parameters.example: mysql synchronizes to hologres heartbeat alert
parameters.help_en: The description of the alert rule
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The metric type in the alert rule. Valid values:

Heartbeat

FailoverCount

Delay
parameters.help_zh:
告警指标类型，可选的枚举值：
Heartbeat（任务状态报警）
FailoverCount（failover次数报警）
Delay（任务延迟报警）
parameters.name: metric_type

fields.help_en: The time interval for alert calculation. Unit: minutes
fields.help_zh: 告警计算时间区间，单位分钟
fields.name: duration

fields.help_en:
The severity level. Valid values:

Warning

Critical
fields.name: severity

fields.help_en:
The alert threshold.

If the alert rule is for task status, you do not need to specify a threshold.

If the alert rule is for failovers, you must specify the number of failovers.

If the alert rule is for latency, you must specify the latency duration, in seconds
fields.help_zh:
告警阈值。

任务状态报警：无需填写阈值。
failover次数报警：阈值为failover次数。
任务延迟报警：阈值为延迟时长，单位秒
fields.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: The conditions that are used to trigger the alert rule
parameters.help_zh: 告警触发条件列表，支持多条件
parameters.name: trigger_conditions

fields.help_en: The duration of the alert suppression interval. Default value: 5. Unit: minutes
fields.help_zh: 告警抑制间隔时长，单位分钟，默认5分钟
fields.name: inhibition_interval

fields.help_en:
The severity level. Valid values:

Warning

Critical
fields.help_zh:
严重程度，可选的枚举值：
Warning
Critical
fields.name: severity

fields.help_zh: 告警通知渠道，支持多值
fields.name: notification_channels

fields.help_en:
The recipient type.

If the alert notification method is Mail, Phone, or Sms, the recipient type is the Alibaba Cloud account ID.

If the alert notification method is Ding, the recipient type is the DingTalk chatbot token
fields.help_zh:
接收方类型。

当告警通知渠道为邮件、电话、短信时，接收方类型选择阿里云用户ID。
当告警通知渠道为钉钉时，接收方类型选择钉钉token
fields.name: receiver_type

fields.help_en: The settings of alert notification recipients
fields.help_zh: 告警通知接收方，支持多值
fields.name: notification_receivers

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the alert rule. By default, the alert rule is disabled
parameters.help_zh: 告警规则是否启用，默认不开启
parameters.name: enabled
